updates.note: Management reaffirmed the EBITDA margin guidance range of 19% to 21% for the coming year.
updates.quote: We're still confident that we will operate between 19% to 21%. ... that's what we'll be targeting for the coming year as well.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed the marketing spend target of close to 5%.
updates.quote: We target to take that up to close to 5% in the next year.

updates.note: Management confirmed that JKY Groove is being extended to about 500 exclusive brand stores.
updates.quote: we are actually extending it to about 500 exclusive brand stores and select multi-brand stores

new_promises.statement: Targeting to realize around INR40 crores to INR50 crores of subsidy in FY27.
new_promises.quote: in FY27, we have plans to start realizing the subsidies. So over the year, I think we are expecting we should be getting around INR40 crores to INR50 crores of subsidy
new_promises.speaker: Deepanjan Bandyopadhyay
